Prayer cord (기도의 끈)
nodes.rationale: Each family in the small group is a knot slot; praying for neighbouring families tightens the cord and praying for all ties a ribbon. Shows connection without counts or rankings.

nodes.label: Monthly art collection (이달의 그림)
nodes.rationale: Private picture that fills with a hero per prayed day, a prop per newly prayed family, hearts for same-day repeats; never compared with others and never decreases.

nodes.label: Prayer item visibility scopes (room / dept / leader / family)
nodes.rationale: Each prayer item chooses who may see it; 'family only' items are never exported or shown in meet mode; tapping cycles scope.

nodes.label: No competition / no ranking principle
nodes.rationale: Who prayed how many times is hidden even from leaders; analytics show only aggregates, colour plus numbers, fixed room order.

nodes.label: Demo / tutorial / scene modes
nodes.rationale: ?demo, ?tutorial and scene (?as/&at) run the Apps Script server code inside the browser via demo/gas-shim.js so practice never touches real data.

nodes.label: Tutorial practice page (?tutorial)
nodes.rationale: First-time members with no items this month are sent once to a separate practice page; completion recorded server-side (me.tourDone) with device fallback.

nodes.label: Optimistic UI with serialized save queue
nodes.rationale: Server (Apps Script) takes 2-4 s, so the UI changes first and saves are chained one by one; the last reply reconciles the month, failures refetch.

nodes.label: Anonymous usage logging (design ch.10)
nodes.rationale: Random device id, only actions/numbers, queued locally and sent with start; no names or prayer text.

nodes.label: Department vocabulary (group name, unit, josa)
nodes.rationale: Small-group name (사랑방/순/셀...) and unit (가정/개인) per department change all UI wording and Korean particles.

nodes.label: Operations admin mode (S.op)
nodes.rationale: Ops/church-wide admins manage departments without a family and the server never sends prayer content.

nodes.label: Autonomous prayer groups (자율 모임)
nodes.rationale: Member-created groups with end date (max 1 year), 12 people, 3 places per person; deleted with all records at end.

nodes.label: Shared weave (함께 짜는 그물) 3D picture
nodes.rationale: Group prayer records rendered as threads between anonymous pegs on a hoop with three.js; no numbers shown.

nodes.label: Year reorganisation wizard
nodes.rationale: Paste roster -> match names -> leaders -> preview and schedule; applied automatically on the 1st of the start month.

nodes.label: Meet mode (모임 모드)
nodes.rationale: Full-screen family-by-family view of room-scope items for group meetings, ending with the Lord's Prayer.

nodes.label: Kingdom prayer pages (하나님 나라)
nodes.rationale: Daily petition and scripture prayer chosen deterministically by date from topics/seasons; staff can edit texts stored server-side.

nodes.label: Guided prayer session (기도하기)
nodes.rationale: Quiet one-card-at-a-time flow: room families -> my family -> serving staff -> kingdom; per-card timer, auto-advance, hymns.

nodes.label: Add to home screen / PWA
nodes.rationale: Suggest installing once after first contribution on touch devices; service worker sw.js caches files.

nodes.label: Client-side XLSX export
nodes.rationale: Builds an uncompressed (stored) zip of SpreadsheetML in the browser; never includes family-only items.
